The application invokes ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe as separate processes. The
FFmpeg DLLs are shipped beside them; they are not linked into the .NET app.
The build configuration records enabled external integrations. Consult their
upstream license terms for those components in addition to the included FFmpeg
LGPL license.
